text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph organization with introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The writing is structured into a clearer essay form with more effective grouping of ideas and a stronger overall progression."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"A teachers main job...\" and \"Learning and understanding something new...\"","quality":"paragraph development","description":"Each paragraph is more clearly focused on one main point and then expanded with supporting explanation."},{"evidence":"\"can get quite frustrating,\" \"one class period is not long enough,\" \"safe place\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay develops its claims with more specific explanation rather than repeating the same idea in slightly different words."},{"evidence":"\"visual learners,\" \"verbal learners,\" \"one-on-one class\"","quality":"specific support","description":"It uses more concrete examples and details to make its points more convincing."},{"evidence":"\"its,\" \"they're,\" \"dont,\" \"proffered\"","quality":"conventions","description":"Although there are still many errors, the essay shows somewhat stronger control of spelling, punctuation, and capitalization than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"teachers and students are volunteering,\" \"students understand certain things better\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The sentences are generally longer and more varied, showing a stronger attempt at complex expression."}]}
